propositions: Compacted authorship-ledger entries retain pre-rewrite commit SHAs; when commit history is rewritten, the verifier incorrectly misclassifies authentic ledger entries as key-not-valid-at-era instead of resolving positions against the current history.

The verifier must treat ledger commit_sha as a cache and prefer the commit resolved from the entry's position in current history over the stored SHA, falling back to the recorded SHA only when position resolution fails.

A real-Git regression with signed events and ledger compaction must prove that after history rewrite with identical ticket tree, all compacted ledger entries verify correctly and event verdicts remain unchanged.
Live-event behavior, ledger wire format, event bytes, and null-commit recovery behavior must remain unchanged after the fix.

Post-rewrite disposition counts and (event_uuid, verdict, grandfathered) multisets must be identical when commit SHAs are ignored, proving the fix restores the authorship identity invariant across the history rewrite.
